```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(haven)
library(stringr)
```

1.Construct data set from RAND fat files and LHMS that includes
trauma variables and childhood adveristy variables 


```{r}
if (Sys.info()["sysname"] == "Windows") {
  data_directory <- "D:/OneDrive - University of Southern California/Data/HRS/RANDFatFiles"
} else if (Sys.info()["sysname"] == "Darwin") { 
  data_directory <- "/Users/eleanorhayes-larson/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofSouthernCalifornia/Data/HRS/RANDFatFiles"
}

full_directory_names <- list.files(data_directory, full.names = TRUE) %>%
  str_subset(pattern = "^*\\.sas7bdat")

part_filenames <- list.files(data_directory, full.names = FALSE) %>%
  str_subset(pattern = "^*\\.sas7bdat")
```


```{r}
#hrsfilenames stores the file names.
#full_directory_names stores the file paths
hrsfilenames <-
  lapply(X = part_filenames,
         FUN = stringi::stri_sub,
         to = -10)

names(full_directory_names) <- hrsfilenames
```


```{r}
print(full_directory_names)
```


```{r}
# Only need 2004-2012 waves

full_directory_names$all_fat <- NULL # stacked data set with subset of vars
full_directory_names$sasfmts <- NULL # sas format data
full_directory_names$a95f2b <- NULL # 1995
full_directory_names$ad95f2b <- NULL # 1995
full_directory_names$h96f4a <- NULL # 1996
full_directory_names$h98f2c <- NULL # 1998
full_directory_names$hd98f2c <- NULL # 1998
full_directory_names$h00f1d <- NULL # 2000
full_directory_names$h02f2c <- NULL # 2002
full_directory_names$h14f2b <- NULL # 2014
full_directory_names$h16f2c <- NULL # 2016
full_directory_names$h18f2b <- NULL # 2018
full_directory_names$h20f1a <- NULL # 2020
full_directory_names$h20e2a <- NULL # 2020
full_directory_names$h06f3a <- NULL # old 2006
full_directory_names$hd10f5f <- NULL # old 2010

```


```{r}
print(full_directory_names)
```



```{r}
## Read in fat files ---- 
hrsfatfiles <- lapply(FUN = read_sas, X = full_directory_names)
hrsfatfiles_clean <- list()
```




```{r}
### filter variables of interest ----
#trauma variables,childhood adversity variables:contains("b037k"), contains("b037l"), contains("b037m"), contains("b037n")
for (i in 1:length(hrsfatfiles)){
  colnames(hrsfatfiles[[i]]) <- tolower(colnames(hrsfatfiles[[i]]))
  hrsfatfiles_clean[[i]] <- hrsfatfiles[[i]] %>% 
    mutate(hrswave = full_directory_names[i],
           hhidpn = str_pad(hhidpn,9,pad="0")) %>%
    select(c(hhidpn, 
    # 2006,2008,2010,2012: HAS A CHILD OF YOURS EVER DIED, SP OR CHILD HAVE LIFE-THREATENING, LIFE-THREATENING ILLNESS
    #SP OR PARTNER ADDICTED TO DRUGS, BEEN IN A MAJOR FIRE OR DISASTER,FIRE A WEAPON IN COMBAT,DRINK DRUGS CAUSED FAMILY PROBS
    #EVER VICTIM OF PHYSICAL ATTACK,PHYSICAL ABUSED BY PARENTS BF 18
    #LB037H:AMOUNT TIME/ATTENTION MOTHER, LB037I:EFFORT FROM MOTHER, LB037J:AMT MOTHER TEACH ABOUT LIFE
             contains("b037a"), contains("b037b"), contains("b037c"),
             contains("b037d"), contains("b037e"), contains("b037f"), 
             contains("b037g"), contains("b037h"), contains("b037i"),
             contains("b037j"), contains("b037k"), contains("b037l"), contains("b037m"),
             contains("b037n"),
    #2004: EXP DEATH OF ANY CHILD OF YOURS,SP OR CHILD HAVE LIFE-THREATENING,VICTIM OF PHYSICAL ATTACK
    #	LIFE-THREATENING ILLNESS,
             contains("lb527")))
}
```





```{r}
### clean fat file data ----
# Assign wave names to list and sort before binding
names(hrsfatfiles_clean) <- names(hrsfatfiles)
hrsfatfiles_clean <- hrsfatfiles_clean[c("h04f1c", "h06f4a",
                                         "h08f3a", "hd10f6a", "h12f3a")]

hrsfatfiles_join <- hrsfatfiles_clean %>% 
  reduce(full_join, by = "hhidpn")
```


1.lifetime trauma

```{r}
#Filter to keep only columns related to trauma variables, a-g: lifetime trauma
hrsfatfiles_join_subset <- hrsfatfiles_join %>%
  select(hhidpn, 
         contains("b037a"), contains("b037b"), contains("b037c"),
         contains("b037d"), contains("b037e"), contains("b037f"), 
         contains("b037g"),-matches(".*y$"))#Remove columns related to year
```



```{r}
#trauma question in 2006 and 2010
hrsfatfiles_join_km <- hrsfatfiles_join_subset %>%
  select(hhidpn, starts_with("k"), starts_with("m"))%>% 
  mutate(baseline_year=2006)
```





```{r}
#Keep individuals who answered at least one question in both 2006 and 2010.
k_cols <- grep("^k", names(hrsfatfiles_join_km), value = TRUE)
m_cols <- grep("^m", names(hrsfatfiles_join_km), value = TRUE)

hrsfatfiles_join_km_filter <- hrsfatfiles_join_km[
  rowSums(!is.na(hrsfatfiles_join_km[, k_cols])) > 0 &
  rowSums(!is.na(hrsfatfiles_join_km[, m_cols])) > 0,
]
#5528
```





```{r}
#trauma question in 2008 and 2012
hrsfatfiles_join_ln <- hrsfatfiles_join_subset %>%
  select(hhidpn, starts_with("l"), starts_with("n"))%>% 
  mutate(baseline_year=2008)
```



```{r}
#Keep individuals who answered at least one question in both 2008 and 2012.
l_cols <- grep("^l", names(hrsfatfiles_join_ln), value = TRUE)
n_cols <- grep("^n", names(hrsfatfiles_join_ln), value = TRUE)

hrsfatfiles_join_ln_filter <- hrsfatfiles_join_ln[
  rowSums(!is.na(hrsfatfiles_join_ln[, l_cols])) > 0 &
  rowSums(!is.na(hrsfatfiles_join_ln[, n_cols])) > 0,
]
#4742
```

```{r}
    police_2008 = llb037l,
    parent_drugs_2008 = llb037m,
    parent_abuse_2008 = llb037n,
    police_2010 = mlb037l,
    parent_drugs_2010 = mlb037m,
    parent_abuse_2010 = mlb037n,
    police_2012= nlb037l,
```

```{r}
#change the order of columns
core_childhood <- core_childhood %>%
  select(
    hhidpn,
    parent_drugs_2006, parent_drugs_2008, parent_drugs_2010, parent_drugs_2012,

  )
```



```{r}
#Use the first non-NA value as the final selection
core_childhood <- core_childhood %>%
  mutate(
    parent_drugs  = coalesce(parent_drugs_2006, parent_drugs_2008, parent_drugs_2010, parent_drugs_2012),
    parent_abuse = coalesce(parent_abuse_2006, parent_abuse_2008, parent_abuse_2010, parent_abuse_2012),
    police = coalesce(police_2008, police_2010, police_2012)
  )%>%
  select(hhidpn,parent_drugs,parent_abuse,police)
```

3.childhood adversity(LHMS)


```{r}
setwd("D:/OneDrive - University of Southern California/Data/HRS/HRSRawData/Off-Year Studies/Life History")

lhms1517 <- read_sas("./LHMS_Aggregate_2015_2017/lhms1517a_r.sas7bdat")
lhms19spr <- read_sas("./LHMS19SPR/lhms19spr_r.sas7bdat")
lhms19f <- read_sas("D:/OneDrive - University of Southern California/Data/HRS/HRSRawData/Off-Year Studies/Life History/LHMS19FLong/lhms19f_r.sas7bdat")
```




```{r}
## create list of dataframes
lhms_list <- list(lhms1517, lhms19spr,lhms19f)
names(lhms_list) <- c("2017", "2019","2019") 
lhms_clean <- list()
```


```{r}
### filter LH2 variables from LHMS ----
#childhood adveristy variables
for (i in 1:length(lhms_list)) {
  colnames(lhms_list[[i]]) <- tolower(colnames(lhms_list[[i]]))
  colnames(lhms_list[[i]]) <- gsub("_19", "", colnames(lhms_list[[i]]))
  lhms_clean[[i]] <- lhms_list[[i]] %>% 
    mutate(hhidpn = str_pad(paste(hhid, pn, sep = ""), 9, pad = "0"),
           lhms_year = names(lhms_list)[i]) %>%
    select(any_of("hhidpn"),
           matches("lh2[a-z]"),
           lhms_year)
}
```


```{r}
names(lhms_clean) <- c("lhms1517", "lhms19spr", "lhms19f")
```


```{r}
lhms1517 <- lhms_clean$lhms1517 %>%
  rename(
    orphanage = lh2a,
    fosterhome  = lh2b,
    parent_divorce = lh2d,
    parent_died = lh2e
  )

lhms19spr <- lhms_clean$lhms19spr %>%
  rename(
    orphanage = lh2a,
    fosterhome = lh2b,
    parent_divorce = lh2d,
    parent_died = lh2e
  )

lhms19f <- lhms_clean$lhms19f %>%
  rename(
    orphanage= lh2a,
    fosterhome  = lh2b,
    parent_divorce = lh2d,
    parent_died = lh2e
  )
```


```{r}
add_suffix <- function(data, suffix) {
  data %>%
    select(hhidpn, orphanage, fosterhome, parent_divorce, parent_died) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", suffix), -hhidpn)
}

lhms1517  <- add_suffix(lhms1517,  "1517")
lhms19spr <- add_suffix(lhms19spr, "19spr")
lhms19f   <- add_suffix(lhms19f,   "19f")
```


```{r}
lhms_all <- reduce(
  list(lhms1517, lhms19spr, lhms19f),
  full_join,
  by = "hhidpn"
)
```



```{r}
names(lhms_all)
```

```{r}
  select(
    hhidpn,
    starts_with("orphanage"),
    starts_with("fosterhome"),
    starts_with("parent_divorce"),
    starts_with("parent_died")
  )

```



```{r}
lhms_all <- lhms_all %>%
  mutate(
    orphanage = coalesce(orphanage_1517, orphanage_19spr, orphanage_19f),
    fosterhome = coalesce(fosterhome_1517, fosterhome_19spr, fosterhome_19f),
    parent_divorce = coalesce(parent_divorce_1517, parent_divorce_19spr, parent_divorce_19f),
    parent_died = coalesce(parent_died_1517, parent_died_19spr, parent_died_19f)
  ) %>%
```

4.Extract memory score variable from memory score data(cognitive data)


```{r}
#read memory score data
if(Sys.info()["user"]=="user"){

  memimp <- read_sas(paste0("D:/OneDrive - University of Southern California/Data/HRS/HRSCleanData/",
                            "ImputedMemoryScores/",
                            "dpmemimp_jan2024.sas7bdat"))

}
```





```{r}
#add hhidpn and rows where all memimp columns are NA are removed.
colnames(memimp) <- tolower(colnames(memimp))
memimp_filter <- memimp %>% 
  mutate(hhidpn = str_pad(paste(hhid, pn, sep=""),9,pad="0")) %>%
  select(c(hhidpn, starts_with("age"), 
           starts_with("memimp"))) %>%
  filter(if_any(c(starts_with("memimp")), ~ !is.na(.)))
#34766
```





```{r}
#change to long format
memimp_filter_long <- memimp_filter %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(hhidpn),
               names_to = c('.value',"hrswave"),
               names_pattern = "(.*?)(\\d+)$") %>%
  filter(!is.na(memimp))
```




```{r}
#for 2006/2010
memimp_filter_10 <- memimp_filter_long %>%
  mutate(hrswave = as.character(hrswave)) %>%
  filter(hrswave %in% c( "10", "12", "14", "16", "18", "20"))

```




```{r}
#2006/2010 convert back to wide format
memimp_wide_10 <- memimp_filter_10 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = hhidpn,
    names_from = hrswave,
    values_from = c(age, memimp),
    names_glue = "{.value}{hrswave}"
  )
#23684
```



```{r}
#add age06 for baseline age
memimp_wide_10  <- memimp_wide_10 %>%
  left_join(select(memimp_filter, hhidpn, age06), 
            by = "hhidpn")
```
